## Hypothesis

Adjusting sniper strategy parameters (vol_mult, body_min_cents, min_stars, strike_offset, premium_stop_pct, tp1_premium_pct, tp1_qty_fraction, runner_target_pct, profit_lock_threshold_pct, profit_lock_stop_offset_pct, qty, proximity_dollars, require_break_above_open) can improve edge_capture on J anchor days by better capturing winners and reducing losses on loser days.

## Mechanism

Entry triggers on sniper level break with volume filter (vol_mult), minimum body size (body_min_cents), star quality (min_stars), and strike offset (strike_offset). Exit uses premium stop (premium_stop_pct), TP1 (tp1_premium_pct at tp1_qty_fraction), runner target (runner_target_pct), and profit-lock (profit_lock_threshold_pct activated, profit_lock_stop_offset_pct offset). Quantity fixed at qty=10 contracts. Requires break above open (require_break_above_open=true).
